output.title: Four-Bedroom Semi-Detached House with South-Facing Garden and Parking
output.description:
This semi-detached house offers approximately 195 m² of living space with a well-planned layout consisting of four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Constructed in the 1990s and maintained to a high standard, the residence features a brick facade complemented by a small front garden and a private driveway enhancing convenience and privacy.

The interior presents a comfortable living room with tile flooring and a functional fireplace, seamlessly opening onto the dining area. Double doors lead directly to the garden, promoting a smooth transition between indoor and outdoor living spaces. The kitchen is equipped with traditional wood cabinetry, a tile splashback, a freestanding range, and a dedicated breakfast nook, providing a practical environment for daily meals.

The garden benefits from a south-facing orientation, allowing for ample daylight throughout the day. It includes a lawn area and a private patio, offering an outdoor setting for relaxation or entertaining. Additional amenities comprise a cellar for storage and designated parking, adding to the functionality of the property.

Situated in an established residential area, this house reflects typical 1990s Luxembourg architecture and offers a quiet setting, with all essential residential features in place. The combination of spacious interior, outdoor living options, and practical facilities makes this property a notable example of a well-maintained family home.
